name: Winter closure of HaminaKotka
description: HaminaKotka closed for 14 days in winter, Helsinki at 60% capacity, Lahti-Kouvola rail at half capacity, a temporary food demand surge in South Karelia and a nationwide food stockpiling spike (x1.3, days 3-8). Single-port closure: with warehouse stocks and import redirection to other ports, little or no shortage of essentials is the expected outcome.
